Two things to check before it goes into Kwame's review:
- Ticket #4419 appears in the cheat sheet under Pellucid (Yard_Dwell_Summary timing out), but Moss's 11/2 digest lists it under Puget Sound Operations (barge slip 7). I flagged it rather than picking one.
- Most of the items have no ticket number. The DMF items in particular would need a check in the support queue.

I read the Coastal channels you're in, the Coastal digests and cheat sheet, and your own cutover recap. I did not use the #strategic channels or search across all messages.
